data_output.description: Unchanged interface from data.py: load returns canonical date-filtered train, valid, and test source-row sequences; test labels are withheld when include_test_labels=False. encode returns encoded[split] = (features, labels, users), with features shaped (N, 5) and ordered as [user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday]. Raw fields are exactly user_id, video_id, tab, hourmin, and date; hour is floor(numeric hourmin / 100) constrained to 0..23, and weekday is the Monday=0 through Sunday=6 calendar weekday from YYYYMMDD date. Validation and test prediction row order is this unchanged encoded split order.

model_input.description: Unchanged Model interface: Model.step receives aligned nonempty positive_features and negative_features arrays of equal shape (pair_count, 5). train.py must construct these by indexing training features with aligned int64 positive_indices and negative_indices. For each eligible training positive, build up to four pairs against distinct same-user training negatives, uniformly sampled without replacement when at least four negatives exist; otherwise use all available same-user negatives once. Model.predict receives a (N, 5) feature matrix and returns one score per input row.
